body:

## Summary

Implements issue #238: establishes the `semprec-api` REST adapter foundation — shared authentication, request validation, item envelope, and error contract — with no concrete generic resource routes mounted yet (those come in #155-158, and route manifests/mounting in #239).

**Changes:**
- `backend/packages/data/src/errors.ts`: added four `ChokePointError` subclasses for codes the error contract needs that didn't have a dedicated class yet — `SchemaLockedError`, `PropertyLockedError`, `ApprovalRequiredError`, `HeartbeatEventTriggeredError`.
- `backend/services/semprec-api/src/adapter/itemEnvelope.ts` (new): the `{ id, databaseId, properties, computed, updatedAt, deletedAt }` wire envelope and its projection from `ItemRow`.
- `backend/services/semprec-api/src/adapter/errorContract.ts` (new): the closed nine-code enum, the single code→status table, and `toErrorResponseBody`/`statusForError`, including the `version_conflict` → `details.currentItem` projection.
- `backend/services/semprec-api/src/adapter/requestValidation.ts` (new): shared path/query/header/body validators that fail with `validation_failed`.
- `backend/services/semprec-api/src/adapter/adapterRoute.ts` (new): `createAdapterRequestListener` — wraps a route handler with the shared `authenticateRequest` auth gate (no per-route opt-out), JSON body parsing, and error/envelope serialization; documents the no-URL-versioning, additive-only contract evolution rule.
- Contract tests: `errorContract.unit.test.ts` (all nine codes → documented status/body) and `adapterRoute.test.ts` (integration — unauthenticated rejection, validation failure, successful full-envelope write, `version_conflict`/`not_found` mapping) via fixture handlers, per the issue's "no concrete routes yet" scope.

**Test plan:**
- [x] `pnpm run verify` in `backend/` (lint, format, build, unit/integration/e2e tests) — 82 test files, 922 tests, all passing.
- [x] No `web/` changes, so its pipeline doesn't apply.

## Summary

Pushed the review-fix commit for issue #238 to the existing branch `bb/relay-238-generic-rest-01-09-establish-the-sempr-thr_5eaxjabx4q`. The remote had moved ahead with a merge of `develop` in the meantime, so I merged that into the local branch (no conflicts) before pushing, and re-ran the full pipeline afterward to confirm nothing regressed.

**Changes since the last push, addressing PR #376's review findings:**
- Added `docs/adr/2026-09-11-additive-only-rest-contract-no-url-versioning.md`, recording the no-URL-versioning / additive-only contract-evolution decision that `adapterRoute.ts`'s JSDoc already asserted (medium finding — missing ADR).
- Added a test case for the previously-untested 413 `payload_too_large` branch in `adapterRoute.test.ts` (medium finding — untested error path).
- Tightened `isVersionConflictDetails` in `errorContract.ts` to validate `current`'s required `ItemRow` fields instead of just the presence of a `current` key (low finding).
- Made `requireAuthenticatedIdentity`, `readJsonBody`, `sendErrorResponse`, `sendItemResponse` module-private in `adapterRoute.ts`, since `createAdapterRequestListener` is the only supported entry point and nothing else called them (low finding).

**Verification:** `pnpm run verify` in `backend/` — 83 test files, 932 tests, exit code 0, after merging in `develop`'s intervening changes.
